corrections.reason: The printed word in the image has five characters (የሚወጣው, intransitive 'that which comes out'), translating Ge'ez ይወፅእ without an extra ያ.
The initial character is 1st-order ከ (ከነናዊት, 'Concerning the Canaanite woman'), matching the spelling in lines 11–14.
The Ge'ez enclitic particle is ኑ (ከለባትኒ ኑ ይበልዑ, Matthew 15:27, glossed in the Andemta at L28 as ውሾችም እንጂ ውሾችም እኮን), misread as non-word ጓ due to ink bleed.
Both the printed glyph (4th-order ባ without a right foot) and Classical Ge'ez gender agreement with feminine ሃይማኖትኪ require the feminine adjective ዓባይ (Matthew 15:28).
